metadata.name: agari_parlay
metadata.description: Masayume's MarketMakerVault on Solana: house-banked multi-leg tickets priced off the venue's own books

instructions.name: noop
docs: The instruction set lands with the open and resolve steps; the arithmetic and the balance sheet are here.

errors.name: Paused
errors.msg: the reserve is paused

errors.name: BadLegCount
errors.msg: a ticket needs at least the minimum number of legs and no more than the maximum

errors.name: DuplicateLeg
errors.msg: the same Window cannot be two legs of one ticket

errors.name: WindowNotTrading
errors.msg: that Window is not open for calls

errors.name: NoOpeningPrint
errors.msg: that Window has no opening print yet

errors.name: NoClosingPrint
errors.msg: that Window has no closing print yet

errors.name: ThinBook
errors.msg: the venue's book is too thin to price that leg

errors.name: TooLate
errors.msg: too little time is left in one of those Windows

errors.name: LongShot
errors.msg: the combination is too much of a long shot

errors.name: Underpriced
errors.msg: the stake would not be less than the payout

errors.name: OverPayoutCap
errors.msg: the payout exceeds the reserve's per-ticket cap

errors.name: StakeAboveMax
errors.msg: the fresh stake is above the most the buyer agreed to pay

errors.name: InsufficientLiquidity
errors.msg: the reserve cannot back that payout right now

errors.name: OverExposure
errors.msg: that would take the reserve past its exposure limit

errors.name: OverExpiryCap
errors.msg: too much of the reserve already settles at that boundary

errors.name: TicketNotLive
errors.msg: the ticket is not live

errors.name: LegAlreadyResolved
errors.msg: that leg has already been resolved

errors.name: WrongLeg
errors.msg: that leg is not part of this ticket

errors.name: LegsPending
errors.msg: the ticket still has legs waiting on their Windows

errors.name: TicketNotSettled
errors.msg: the ticket has not been settled

errors.name: TicketDidNotWin
errors.msg: the ticket did not win

errors.name: NotStale
errors.msg: the ticket is not stale enough to void

errors.name: WrongEngine
errors.msg: that Market belongs to a different engine

errors.name: WrongExpiry
errors.msg: that expiry book belongs to a different boundary

errors.name: InsufficientShares
errors.msg: that wallet does not hold that many shares

errors.name: ZeroAmount
errors.msg: the amount is zero

errors.name: NoEquity
errors.msg: the reserve has no equity to price shares against

errors.name: MathOverflow
errors.msg: arithmetic overflowed
